name: openpixo/painted-fantasy
title: Hand-painted fantasy
description: Warm brushwork and clear material shapes for story-rich fantasy worlds.

description_i18n.en: Warm brushwork and clear material shapes for story-rich fantasy worlds.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 用温暖笔触与明确材质形体，构建富有故事感的奇幻世界。

examples.title: Herbalist cottage
examples.prompt: Generate a small herbalist cottage concept using the painted-fantasy art style, with weathered green shutters, hanging herbs and warm window light. Keep the building readable as a game location.

prompt_i18n.zh-CN: 使用 painted-fantasy 美术风格生成一间草药师小屋概念图：做旧的绿色百叶窗、悬挂草药、温暖窗光。确保建筑作为游戏地点时仍有清晰轮廓。

examples.title: Enchanted equipment
examples.prompt: Create three matching equipment icons using the painted-fantasy art style: a copper lantern, a leaf-carved staff and a worn leather satchel. Share the same warm light and restrained magical glow.

prompt_i18n.zh-CN: 使用 painted-fantasy 美术风格制作三枚配套装备图标：铜灯笼、刻叶纹的法杖和旧皮挎包。统一暖光，并让魔法辉光保持克制。

style.prompt: Hand-painted fantasy game artwork with opaque brush shapes, textured color edges and carefully grouped values. Warm highlights against cool soft-edged shadows, readable stylized anatomy and distinct wood, stone, cloth and metal materials. Simplify detail toward the silhouette, preserve visible brushwork and use a restrained earthy palette with small luminous accents.
style.negativePrompt: photographic realism, plastic surface, hard vector gradients, airbrushed gloss, over-detailed noise, muddy value grouping, oversaturated rainbow colors, text, signature, watermark

constraints.outline: Painted edge definition without a uniform ink contour.
